expected.note_en: Issuer identified a EUR255m shareholder cash injection as part of its restructuring. The exact legal instrument, named contributing vehicle, payment date and completion were not established from this announcement.

reversal.note_en: Issuer identified a EUR255m shareholder cash injection as part of its restructuring. The exact legal instrument, named contributing vehicle, payment date and completion were not established from this announcement.

replace.note_en: The legacy issuer's 2017 industrial plan announced a proposed EUR255m shareholder cash injection, repeated in May 2018. The extraordinary administrator later described the earlier rescue plans as unfulfilled. Cash receipt and exact execution are unverified. Withheld pending separate execution evidence.
